summary: Deschutes forest lookout on Big Hole Butte, Lake County: a 20-foot tower built in 1932 and removed or destroyed in 1958. Only a 2001 photo of a foundation block is described.

facts.design: 20-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1958 per the register (firelookout.com says destroyed); a 2001 register photo shows a foundation block for one tower leg; no source describes the site today

events.note: Telephone line built from Summit Stage Station to the summit, per a 1970 Bend Bulletin account
Neil Winkle left in June 1932 to be forest fire lookout at Big Hole Butte
20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, constructed in 1932
Roderick Blacker is the lookout in January 1936
Register: removed in 1958; firelookout.com: destroyed in 1958
Register photo dated 5/2/2001 shows a foundation block for a tower leg

sources.title: Big Hole Butte Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: The register says the tower was removed in 1958; firelookout.com says destroyed. The story reports both and does not choose. The register's only photo is the 2001 foundation-block image; no current description was found. One search found nothing newer about the site. Brief elevation 1561.2 m matches the register's 5,122 ft. No fire events appear in the sources read. The register's map image was not read.
